framework_labels: MITRE ATT&CK | T1041 | Exfiltration Over Command and Control Channel
retrieval_text:
INCIDENT TYPE:
DATA EXFILTRATION

DESCRIPTION:
Data exfiltration is the unauthorized transfer of sensitive information from an organization's environment to external locations. Attackers often exfiltrate data before ransomware deployment or during espionage operations.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1041 | Exfiltration Over Command and Control Channel

INDICATORS:
- Large outbound transfers
- Unusual cloud uploads
- Encrypted outbound traffic
- Data compression activity
- Transfers outside business hours

DETECTION RULES:
- Large outbound transfers
- Unusual destination connections
- Cloud storage uploads

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Databases
- File servers
- Cloud storage
title: DATA EXFILTRATION
